title: Play while waiting starts speech when audio arrives
description:
## Behavior

Home copy says Press play, but Play is disabled until the job is done, so a click does nothing. After the embed boots, Play should accept the click and start the clip as soon as audio is ready.

```gherkin
Feature: Player playback restart
  Scenario: Play while waiting starts when audio is ready
    Given the player is waiting for audio
    When the listener activates Play
    And the clip becomes ready
    Then playback starts
```

## Implementation brief

1. `embed/src/player/index.ts` — keep Play clickable while waiting; set a pending flag; `audio.play()` when `done` + `audio_url`. Honor `data-auritus-play-intent` on the player host.
2. `site/components/AuritusPlayerHost.tsx` — first-paint Play is clickable and sets that intent.
3. `site/tests/acceptance.spec.ts` — `waitForPlayableClip` must require `audio.src`, not merely `!disabled`.
4. Vitest for the pending-play path. Do not enable PyPI.

comments.text: Merged PR #42. Play while waiting starts the clip when audio is ready. First-paint Play records the same intent. CI quality passed.
